crossRefs.note: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

translations.web: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
translations.bsb: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
translations.kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
translations.asv: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
